title: fix(plugin-kanban): a reference swimlane heading reads the target object's nameField
body:
Fixes #36930
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 看板按关联字段分泳道时,泳道标题改为和列标题一样,用被关联对象声明的名称字段显示记录;此前两处可能把同一条记录叫成不同的名字。
- 属于看板关联分组(按关联字段分列、分泳道)的收尾,让泳道标题服从"名称字段是唯一主标题"的既有裁决。
- 出错时只是泳道标题显示成别的字段的文字,卡片归属和拖拽不受影响;改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`ObjectKanban` reads the swimlane field's referenced object once per board (`useSettledSchema`, the hook the column-lane path already uses for `laneTargetDef`) and hands it to the board as a prop, `swimlaneTargetDef`. `KanbanBoardCore` forwards it to `KanbanImpl`, which passes it to `lanesFromRecords` in place of the hard-coded `undefined`. So a reference swimlane is titled through `referencedRecordTitle` exactly as a column lane over the same reference is: the field's `displayField`, then the target's declared `nameField` (ADR-0079), then the shared ladder.

- No exported type changes. `swimlaneTargetDef` lands on `KanbanBoardCoreProps` and `KanbanBoardProps`, neither of which the package index re-exports. `KanbanRendererProps`, `ObjectKanbanComponentProps` and `KanbanLaneRows` are untouched.
- `effectiveSwimlaneField` moved up next to the lane-target read (same expression) so the hook can key on it; no other use changed.
- `KanbanRenderer` (the exported React-host component in `index.tsx`) is not changed. It holds no data source, so it cannot read the target object; its swimlane heading keeps the field's `displayField`, then the shared ladder on the expanded record. Its column lanes come from the host's authored `schema.columns`, so it has no reference column-lane heading to disagree with. Giving it the target def would need a new member on the exported `KanbanRendererProps`; that is left out of this PR.

## Tests

`ObjectKanban.swimlaneNameField-36930.test.tsx` (new): the target `account` declares `nameField: 'code'` and its expanded records also carry `name`, which the shared ladder would pick without the target def.

- (a) the swimlane headings read `ZZ-1` / `ZZ-2` (the `code`), not `Acme Corp`;
- (b) they equal the column-lane headings of a board grouped by the same lookup.

## Acceptance notes

- The column-lane and swimlane reads are two `useSettledSchema` calls; when both name the same object the data source is asked twice. Not changed here.
